description: In inbound.rs verify_http_signature, the cache is first read under a read lock; if the key is absent or stale, the lock is dropped, the key is fetched, then a write lock is acquired and the new value is written. Between dropping the read lock and acquiring the write lock, multiple concurrent requests for the same key_id can all see the cache miss and all issue duplicate fetches to the remote actor server. This is not a security flaw (all fetches will get the same key) but it does allow an O(concurrent requests) fanout of HTTP calls to a remote server on a cache miss, which is a correctness concern for rate-limiting and DoS resilience. A single-flight mechanism or a double-checked lock under write lock would prevent this.
title: verify_http_signature: TOCTOU race on pub_key_cache between read and write lock
